name: FRAMEN
description:
FRAMEN connects Claude to the FRAMEN digital out-of-home platform. Plan and launch advertising campaigns, set targeting by location, venue type, and audience, manage budgets, and pull real-time performance reporting - all through natural conversation. 
Built on FRAMEN's network of digital screens in gyms, hotels, coworking spaces, retail, and more across 20+ countries.

_published_faq.name: How do I add FRAMEN to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add FRAMEN to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.framen.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the FRAMEN MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: FRAMEN provides these MCP tools: aggregate_campaign_reports, edit_campaign, find_geo_places, get_campaign, get_campaign_report, list_campaign_locations, and list_campaigns.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to FRAMEN?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to FRAMEN in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
FRAMEN requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
FRAMEN is developed by FRAMEN. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
